_about: The English source pairs some hymns with the words of a different hymn (for example 149 'When I Survey' carried 'There is a green hill far away'). align_english.py drops the English for a hymn when the words of its English title do not appear in the first verse. 'verified_ok' overrides that check for hymns whose English is right; 'exclude' drops English that passes the check but is wrong.
